notes.title: Eridani Survivors Release Notes
notes.content:
Changes since the last demo release:

[list]
[*] Added four unlockable pilots to the game, unlockable by completing maps.
[*] Added four unlockable maps to the game, unlockable by completing maps.
[*] Added more/new music, mainly for the new levels. Each level has its own unique background music.
[*] Added more ship types and change the artwork for some existing ships.
[*] Added more attack patterns for enemies, including enemies that shoot. Watch for the red targeting indicator to know what direction an enemy is going to fire from.
[*] Added Steam achievements.
[*] Changed some upgrade skills. There is now a "Repair Drones" skill that will heal your ship, and a "Time Dilation" skill that will slow enemies.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the afterburners upgrades to not work properly.
[*] Fixed a glitch that would allow infinite money duplicated (Thanks, Tim, for the report!)
[*] Improved translations.
[/list]

notes.title: Eridani Survivors Updated
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new music. Each level now has its own background music, and all of the "placeholder music" is gone.
[*] Expanded the area of most maps by 96%, although the second "green nebula" map is unchanged.
[*] Made it so that experience crystals will merge with nearby crystals. The more purple the color, the more experience the crystal is worth.
[*] Enemies that spawn in a circle or cross pattern will now spawn even farther away.
[*] Lifetime kill and coin totals will be shown on the end of game screen.
[*] Added some Steam achievements. I plan to add more before release.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Changes in this version of the demo:

[list]
[*] Added the rocket, missile, laser, and machinegun weapons.
[*] Each pilot now has their own specific starting weapon, and this is shown on the pilot select screen.
[*] The level selection screen now shows the amount of time you need to survive for each level.
[*] You can now view scores for all available levels on the leaderboard screen.
[*] The fourth level now has different music. I plan to have different audio tracks for each level for the full game release.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Changes in this version of the demo:

[list]
[*] Ships and enemies all move a bit faster.
[*] The music volume slider has been fixed.
[*] Added support for Turkish and Polish language.
[*] Mines dropped on the map now do damage to all nearby enemies when exploding and not only the ship contacting them.
[*] The base pickup range has been increased slightly.
[*] The base size of the EM field has been increased slightly.
[*] The arrow keys now work for ship movement in addition to the WSAD keys.
[*] Enemies attacking in a cross or circle pattern now start from farther away.
[*] Added support for leaderboards. Currently only the leaderboard for the first level can be viewed, but scores are submitted for all levels.
[/list]
